scenes.narration: Who do you think buys all the treadmills at Planet Fitness?
Not you. Franchise owners. And they buy them from Planet Fitness itself.
Just that equipment business made 310 million dollars.
It sits right next to franchise fees and its own clubs.
And it still all runs on 20.8 million members.
Members pay monthly. But owners buy the machines.
